changelog: fix_emu_silva.sh: emu build-database copied the headerless taxonomy_list.tsv as it was — taxonomy.tsv came out with two columns (tax_id + one lineage string) and its first taxon taken as the header. The script now rewrites taxonomy.tsv with one column per rank (tax_id species genus family order class phylum superkingdom) from taxonomy_list.tsv, also on a database it built before. emu_pipeline refuses a database whose taxonomy.tsv has no genus/species column and points to the script. No backend restart needed.

previous.changelog: ONT 16S: (1) new fix_emu_silva.sh — turns a half-built databases/emu_silva (build_emu_db.py intermediates, taxonomy.tsv -> taxonomy_list.tsv) into a working Emu database, from emu_silva/prep/silva_db when complete or with emu build-database; leftovers are moved to ~/r16s-db-backup/emu_silva_src. (2) emu_pipeline checks the database before starting and says plainly when it is not a built Emu database, instead of Emu's KeyError 'tax_id'. (3) vsearch (chimera removal) and chopper are now found in the app's conda environments (emu, ngamp-wgs, ngamp-phylo) — chimera removal was being skipped with 'vsearch not found'; a built Emu database's species_taxid.fasta serves as the chimera reference. No backend restart needed.
